## Why

Every later slice is test-first and needs a known layout, one set of check
commands, and project guidance for agents. The owner chose Go with the standard
library only (C24), Go caches inside the repo (C33), and GPL-3.0-or-later (C31).
PROJECT.md predates these decisions (it still says dlog, Python, TOML and
MIT/Apache), so AGENTS.md must say the catalog decisions win.

## Implement

1. `go.mod` with the module path from C23 and no dependencies.
2. `cmd/adj/main.go` and `internal/cli` using only the standard library
   (`flag`, `fmt`, `io`, `os`). Every Go file starts with
   `// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later`.
3. Exit-code convention for all commands: decide and record it once (C32).
   Proposed: 0 success, 1 a failed operation or failed check, 2 a usage error.
4. `scripts/env.sh`: find the repo root from the script's own location (so each
   worktree uses its own `.cache/`), then export `GOCACHE=$root/.cache/go-build`,
   `GOMODCACHE=$root/.cache/gomod` and `GOPATH=$root/.cache/gopath`. Proposed
   extras, decided and recorded here (C32): `GOTOOLCHAIN=local` and
   `GOPROXY=off` (no toolchain or module downloads), and `GOTMPDIR`/`TMPDIR`
   under `.cache/tmp` if the sandbox blocks the system temp dir. Never use
   `go env -w` (it writes outside the repo).
5. `.gitignore`: keep `.cache/` and the OS/editor entries; add built binaries
   (`/adj`, `/bin/`, `*.test`) and coverage output (`*.out`); remove the stale
   Python entries (`__pycache__/`, `*.py[cod]`, `*.egg-info/`, `.venv/`, `venv/`).
   Keep or drop `build/` and `dist/` and record it (C32).
6. `LICENSE` for GPL-3.0-or-later (C31). Get the GPL-3.0 text without network,
   only from inside the launch workspace (none was found in the adjudicate repo
   when S01 closed). If there is no local copy, write a `LICENSE` stub that
   states `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` and the standard
   "or (at your option) any later version" notice, marks
   `TODO(owner): replace with the full GPL-3.0 text`, leaves the copyright
   holder as a flagged placeholder unless the owner names one, and says so in
   the handoff note.
7. `AGENTS.md` for the project, short, with:
   - one line on what adjudicate is, and that slicer catalog decisions C23-C33
     override PROJECT.md where they differ (name, runtime, format, license);
   - the layout (`cmd/adj`, `internal/{cli,commands,store,model,query,render}`);
   - setup and checks: `. scripts/env.sh`, `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`,
     `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing; Go caches only under `.cache/` (C33);
   - Go standard library only; any new dependency needs owner approval (C24);
   - test-first with Go `testing`, table-driven where natural; tests use
     `t.TempDir()`, never this repo's own store;
   - tracking rule: work is tracked in slicer; read and change it only through
     the slicer CLI, never by opening or editing `.slicer/`;
   - standing rule (C32): the implementer decides interface details that
     PROJECT.md and the owner's decisions leave open, records each as a slicer
     catalog decision with a one-line reason, the reviewer checks it, and the
     owner may overrule later;
   - owner-only decide (C27): only the owner makes the `adj decide`
     transition; agents ask, check and read;
   - no commits unless the owner asks; no AI attribution.
